title: The Ownership Map 'FK cuts' sheet has no rows while 48 cross-owner foreign keys exist
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Ownership Map v1.xlsx
description: Sheet 'FK cuts' has the header row only (From table, From owner, To table, To owner, Becomes). Physical Schema v6 has 92 foreign keys, and 48 of them join two tables with different owners in sheet Tables, so the sheet that the WP names as the source of the cuts is empty.
evidence: openpyxl max_row=1 on sheet 'FK cuts'; compat/ownership.py fk_cuts() parses inline REFERENCES inside CREATE TABLE, while v6 writes every key as ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT.
proposed: Derive the 48 cuts from sheet Tables: a foreign key is kept only when both tables share an owner; otherwise the column stays uuid. Record the 48 rows in the README and the ERD.

title: rwb-valuation owns no table in the Ownership Map
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Ownership Map v1.xlsx
description: All 93 tables are assigned, but no table has owner S1. Architecture v5 slide 18 gives rwb-valuation the route decision and slide 41 the valuations, yet the map keeps valuation_ext in P1 and every route-economics table in ACE (DP11).
evidence: Ownership Map sheet Tables has no row with Owner S1; ownership.json tables counts S1 = 0; ruling ASM-A6-tables-15 keeps valuation_ext in P1.
proposed: Write rwb_valuation.sql with the schema, the platform library objects and a note; read ACE through the rwb-source-data contract until a TSD adds a local table.

title: The map does not say which schema holds the six PLT library tables
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Ownership Map v1.xlsx
description: Six tables are owned by PLT: outbox_event, outbox_delivery, processed_event, idempotency_key, feature_flag and feature_flag_change. The map gives their schema as 'platform', which is not one of the 19 services, while DP-09 makes the outbox and inbox objects part of every service schema.
evidence: Ownership Map sheet Tables schema column shows 'platform' for the six PLT rows; Architecture v5 slide 20 (every service: outbox relay); DP-09; ruling ASM-A6-tables-8.
proposed: Emit outbox_event, outbox_delivery, processed_event and idempotency_key in all 19 files with no business foreign key; emit feature_flag and feature_flag_change once in rwb_integration.sql for the admin API.

title: The map does not say which schema holds the 30 ACE views
description: The source creates all 31 views in schema recovery. The realignment gives each service its own schema, but the ACE views are shared, read-only projections owned by the ACE view owner and read by rwb-source-data.
evidence: v6 lines 6200-6820 create recovery.v_ace_*; Architecture v5 slide 29 lists recovery.v_ace_* as SELECT-only for rwb-source-data; DP-05.
proposed: Keep the 30 v_ace_* views in schema recovery, read only, in recovery_views.sql, and move v_data_dictionary to rwb_source_data.

title: The source grants use placeholder roles and do not create the 19 logins
description: The grants block is commented and uses :recovery_role and :ace_view_owner. The realignment needs one login per service and per-schema grants, which the source does not contain.
evidence: v6 tail lines 6824-6845; RWB-PLT-NF06 creates the 19 schemas and logins and RWB-PLT-N011 the migrator roles.
proposed: Carry the grants block over as a commented template and point to RWB-PLT-NF06 and RWB-PLT-N011; do not invent role names.

title: The per-service Flyway sequence is not specified
description: v6 states one split (V0001 tables and dictionary, V0002 Tier 1 views, V0003 Tier 2 views). With 19 schemas the sequence per schema is not defined.
evidence: v6 line 8; DP-15 (per-service Flyway sequence); ADR-021.
proposed: One V0001 baseline per service schema; the view file follows the source V0002 and V0003 sections.

title: The four extension tables have no table comment
description: v6 has 89 COMMENT ON TABLE statements for 93 tables. party_ext, contact_point_ext, account_ext and valuation_ext have column comments but no table comment.
evidence: Regex count COMMENT ON TABLE = 89 and CREATE TABLE = 93; the four missing names are the extension tables.
proposed: Keep the source as found; the column comments still feed the dictionary view.

title: lake_copy_watermark has an owner but no target
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Ownership Map v1.xlsx
description: The ruling says the table has no target because the data lake is removed and JOB-13 is continuous Kafka ingest, yet sheet Tables still assigns it to P1 and rwb_source_data.
evidence: Ruling ASM-A6-tables-13; Architecture v5 slide 37 (no data lake) and slide 44 (JOB-13 continuous); DP-17.
proposed: Keep the DDL in rwb_source_data.sql with a retirement note so no source object is lost, and let the P1 DB story drop it.

title: ERD v5 draws 90 foreign keys and Physical Schema v6 has 92
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Entity Relationship Diagram v5.pdf
description: The ERD reference list has 90 foreign keys. v6 adds sys_fields.object_name to sys_objects and sys_objects.data_product to data_product, which the ERD does not draw.
evidence: HTML reference table: 90 rows with Kind = Foreign key; ALTER TABLE regex on v6: 92 rows; the two extra keys are the metadata registry.
proposed: Draw the 108 v5 references unchanged and state the two metadata keys separately in the reconciliation table.

title: ERD v5 has no owner or service grouping
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Entity Relationship Diagram v5.pdf
description: v5 groups by data product (DP01 to DP14, OPS, AGT, RPT) and never names an owning service. The realignment needs one diagram per service.
evidence: v5 pages 1-3 and 91-96; Architecture v5 slides 12, 20, 41; Ownership Map sheet Services.
proposed: Group the v5 objects by the Ownership Map owner and add a cross-service reference table; keep the data-product table of v5 as section 3.
